KIT-227 G1: chunks of inst/reports/transcriptomics/transcriptomics_report.rmd at cf8af245 (base), verbatim: ruv-text

```{r ruv-text, results = "asis"}
# KIT-186: a run without RUV (ruv_applied FALSE: the design none, or a declared design whose k is 0) says so. A run that
# applied RUV prints the two paragraphs of earlier versions, word for word, with the same values.
if (!no_ruv) {
  cat(paste0("Unwanted variation was estimated with RUVs (RUVSeq) on inferred empirical negative control genes: ",
    "the least significant genes of a preliminary group-only quasi-likelihood GLM, taken at a chosen percentage of the ",
    "filtered genes. They are inferred from the data, not known in advance. The selection mode was ",
    value(overlay$ruv_mode %||% ruv$ruv_mode), "; the grid tested ", value(ruv$percentage_min), " to ",
    value(ruv$percentage_max), " % in steps of ", value(ruv$percentage_step), " %, with k capped at ",
    value(ruv$max_acceptable_k), " and a k penalty weight of ", value(ruv$k_penalty_weight),
    ", choosing the maximum composite score. The chosen values were k = ", value(overlay$best_k %||% ruv$k), ", ",
    value(overlay$best_percentage %||% ruv$negative_control_percentage), " % of the genes, giving ",
    value(overlay$num_neg_ctrl %||% ruv$negative_control_count),
    " inferred empirical negative controls, with a separation score of ", value(ruv$separation_score),
    " and a composite score of ", value(ruv$composite_score), ".\n\n"))
  cat(paste0("The RUVs factors W_1..W_k were added to the design and used as model covariates in the differential ",
    "expression model; the counts themselves were not corrected. The RUVs-corrected logCPM was used for display only ",
    "(PCA and RLE figures).\n\n"))
} else if (identical(ruv$ruv_design, "none")) {
  cat(paste0("No correction for unwanted variation was applied: the analysis was run without RUV, as chosen on the ",
    "normalisation tab. The differential expression model held the experimental groups alone (~ 0 + group).\n\n"))
} else {
  # The labels the normalisation tab shows for the design and the k rule.
  design_option <- Filter(function(option) identical(option$id, ruv$ruv_design), MultiScholaR:::omicGuiRuvTableTrx()$options)
  rule <- if (is.character(ruv$ruv_k_rule)) MultiScholaR:::omicGuiRuvKRules()[[ruv$ruv_k_rule]]
  seed <- if (identical(ruv$ruv_k_rule, "num_sv_be")) paste0(", random seed ", value(ruv$ruv_k_seed)) else ""
  cat(paste0("No correction for unwanted variation was applied. The approach chosen on the normalisation tab was '",
    value(if (length(design_option)) design_option[[1L]]$label), "', with the number of unwanted factors set by the rule '",
    value(rule$label), "'", seed, ". The rule found no unwanted factor (k = 0; recorded reason: ",
    value(ruv$ruv_not_applied_reason), "). This means the rule found no factor it could separate from noise, not that ",
    "no unwanted variation is present. The differential expression model held the experimental groups alone ",
    "(~ 0 + group).\n\n"))
}
```
